text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer. Would you mind giving my
shoulders
a good massage?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'd be awful grateful if you packed it full
of
passion. I could use some energy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give Wonder Acute's shoulders a few
hearty
knocks, each one full of my hope
for victory.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it! Your feelings shot straight
into my
heart like an arrow!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm ready for today's race! Get
ready to
celebrate!
